title: External agency pre-approval, MOUs, training, access determinations
summary:
Asked for the records that Policy 462.8(a) / 463.8 and Policy 463.9 describe for each external agency granted access to SMPD's Flock data: pre-approval records, MOUs or data-sharing agreements, configuration records for the Flock statewide/nationwide network, and training verification.

At the time of the request, the SMPD Flock transparency portal listed 285 organizations. The agency response was 'a good faith and diligent search yielded no records responsive to your request' across all four items.

policy_promises.quote: The request is reviewed by the ALPR Committee Captain or the authorized designee and approved before the request is fulfilled.
policy_promises.tests: What pre-approval records exist for external-agency access?
What training-verification records exist for external-agency users?

filed_because: Policy 462.8 / 463.8 and Policy 463.9 describe documented review, approval, and training records for each external agency given access. The request asks for those records across the 285+ organizations then listed on SMPD's transparency portal.
notes:
Subsequent production under W012297-030826 included Flock-originated Camera-Access-Request emails in SMPD inboxes that appear responsive to items 2 and 3.

Follow-up requests: W012596-042226 re-asks items 2/3 citing the later-produced emails, and W012597-042226 covers UOP removal communications.
